Platform & Priorities
## What Dr. Shah Stands For
01
Student Success
### Every Student Deserves to Succeed
Dr. Shah is committed to removing barriers that hold students back — while continuing to invest in those already on the path to success. No student gets left behind. No student stops being supported.
02
Equity & Access
### Breaking Down Barriers to Education
Educating young adults, career changers, and lifelong learners is our greatest investment. A well-educated community competes in a globally and technologically based economy — and strengthens democracy in San Joaquin County.
03
Fiscal Accountability
### Responsible Stewardship of Public Funds & Our People
Taxpayers deserve hard questions and real results. Dr. Shah will bring transparency to the Board — directing every dollar to classrooms and students, while honoring the instructors and staff who make Delta College great.
About the Candidate
## Rooted in This Community
Born and raised in Lodi, Dr. Tony Shah attended Lodi Unified schools, graduated from San Joaquin Delta College, and competed as a student athlete at Lodi High School, Delta College, and Sacramento State.
Delta College changed his life. Supported by his family, his faith, and this community, Dr. Shah became a 26-year educator and administrator — and now a candidate for the Board that shapes Delta's future.
Read Dr. Shah's Full Story
In the news
Lodi News-Sentinel · August 28, 2026
### "Jennings faces first challenger in eight years in Shah"
The Lodi News-Sentinel covered Dr. Tony Shah's campaign for the Delta College Board of Trustees Area 4 seat, featuring his vision for student success and community investment.
Read coverage

## Get Involved Today
A first-generation college student who overcame barriers to learning, Dr. Shah went on to earn a doctorate and serve 26 years in education — 20 as an administrator. Delta College made it possible. Now he's running to make sure it does the same for every student.
